ledger.method: @boundline/ledger reconcile() over flows measured on the fork: collateral out of the position, into the liquidator or the pool, kept by the Protector; USDC paid by the liquidator or out of the pool; debt before and after from Morpho's expectedBorrowAssets. For a liquidation the debt left once the position holds no collateral is the ledger's bad debt, compared with Morpho's badDebtAssets. `strict` is the ledger's exact verdict; `pass` also accepts a miss of one raw unit on the debt identity alone, because Morpho keeps debt in shares and rounds assets up on reads and repays.

runs.outcome: Real borrower 0x8E8745Acd6fbE3e70Afc96042c7F3eC84B1f0e9f (35.3777 AAPLc on the Steakhouse AAPLc/USDC market), staged to venue LTV 0.5600 at Friday's close (debt 6,650.38 USDC). Reopen print -45% (venue LTV 1.0182): the raw venue liquidated all 35.3777 AAPLc, the liquidator repaid 5,796.82 USDC and kept 734.81 USDC of incentive in kind, and Morpho wrote off 853.92 USDC of bad debt against the suppliers (ledger bad debt 853.92, residual vs Morpho 0 units). The same position on a SessionGuard market refused the Saturday liquidation (MarketClosed(5)) and the Saturday borrow, accepted a Saturday repay, and still wrote off 852.96 USDC at the -45% reopen: a session-safe oracle refuses a held price, it does not prevent a gap. Protected mode, default ShadowGuard (30% deviation guard): 7 pre-liquidations as the DEX walked down (-4% to -28%; beyond -30% the guard stops pricing: NO_SHADOW_PRICE), 12.9493 AAPLc sold for 3,634.45 USDC of debt; at the -45% reopen (LTV 0.7442) the liquidation repaid every share, the borrower kept 3.5457 AAPLc and the bad debt was 0.00 USDC. Guard at its 50% maximum: 11 pre-liquidations to -44% and the position was healthy at the -45% reopen (LTV 0.5788; liquidation Error(position is healthy)). Reopen print -15%: the raw venue liquidated with every share repaid, 9.1142 AAPLc left to the borrower, no bad debt. 22 ledger events: 20 close exactly, 2 within one raw unit of Morpho's share rounding (protected (30% deviation guard) step -20%: debt identity off by -1 raw unit (Morpho share rounding); protected (50% deviation guard) step -20%: debt identity off by -1 raw unit (Morpho share rounding)); the ledger's bad debt and Morpho's badDebtAssets agree within one unit on every liquidation; 75 of 75 checks pass.
runs.notes: Fork run, no transactions. Prices move by rewriting the AAPLc aggregator's latest round in place (the replay's transmission-slot technique); the weekend DEX is a mock Slipstream pool at the stepped price (the real Aerodrome TWAP cannot move on a fork without trading through it). Morpho accrues interest inside liquidate before it writes bad debt off, so the supplier loss is measured against the interest-accrued totals (expectedMarketBalances). The SessionGuard leg is a clone account with the same collateral (moved from the Aerodrome pool) and debt on a new market with the same IRM and LLTV.
